recent_specialist_commit.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

candidate.name: Liquid Network Federation BTC peg custody and L-BTC issuance
candidate.scope: BTC locked on Bitcoin mainchain by Liquid federation multisig, backing L-BTC on Liquid one-for-one. Bridge custody stock, not exchange BTC net flow or realized trading demand.

machine_readable.live_access: UNVERIFIED: web direct GET /blocks/tip/height and /blocks/tip/hash inaccessible; independent container GET /blocks/tip/height failed DNS resolution 2026-10-09T11:35:07Z

candidate.identity: PARTIAL: transaction IDs, UTXO outpoints and block hashes documented, but no verified complete federation mainchain custody-address/UTXO inventory bound to one BTC block hash; confidential Liquid outputs can conceal amounts.

point_in_time.effective_at: PARTIAL: block height/hash could identify chain event; no reserve aggregate captured at a specified mainchain block; BTC peg-in requires 102 confirmations before L-BTC claim.
point_in_time.available_at: FAIL: historical first-public availability of aggregate reserve/custody data not demonstrated; block timestamp alone is not availability.
point_in_time.observed_at: FAIL: no successful live reserve payload capture; research observation 2026-10-09T11:35:07Z is a failed access attempt only.

candidate.non_overlap: FAIL_UNPROVEN: locked BTC and issued L-BTC are one backing relationship; avoid counting both as separate reserves or inflows. No demonstrated reconciliation to existing Capital Flow bridge/custody evidence and no verified address-set completeness.
candidate.semantics: CONTEXT_ONLY: reserve/collateral stock must never contribute to directional scoring or synthetic net flow; preserve missingness and do not backfill availability using block timestamp.
candidate.rejection: Although official no-auth Esplora machine API documents immutable tx/block identifiers, direct response was unverified, no complete mainchain federation custody reserve snapshot or address reconciliation is demonstrated, and available/observed PIT clocks fail. Do not queue Gemini.

next_proof: Obtain reproducible historical federation custody address-set and UTXO reconciliation pinned to a Bitcoin block hash, public first-availability capture, and LBTC issuance non-overlap proof; then reassess without changing scoring taxonomy.
